label: Request Method
description: Calls a documented method on the shared ThunderPHP Core\Request object.

properties.name: result_variable
properties.label: Result variable
properties.help: Optional PHP variable name. Omit the $ sign. Leave blank to use the automatic node-specific name.

properties.name: method
properties.label: Method
properties.help: Selecting a method rebuilds the parameter connectors and updates the Result connector type from the documented signature.

methods.name: method
methods.label: Request Method
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request method as an uppercase string such as GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.
methods.help:
Returns the current HTTP request method as an uppercase string such as GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.

### Example

```php
$req = new \Core\Request();
echo $req->method(); // GET, POST, PUT, DELETE etc
```

### Notes

- Use this when a controller needs to distinguish GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, or another HTTP method.

methods.name: posted
methods.label: Is POST Request
methods.description: Returns true only when the current HTTP request method is POST.

methods.name: is_get
methods.label: Is GET Request
methods.description: Returns true when the current HTTP request method is GET.

methods.name: is_ajax
methods.label: Is AJAX Request
methods.description: Detects AJAX requests by inspecting the HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH header.

methods.name: post
methods.label: Read POST Value
methods.description: Reads one POST value with a fallback, or returns the full POST array when no key is supplied.

methods.name: input
methods.label: Read Input Value
methods.description: Convenience alias for reading posted input with a default fallback.

methods.name: get
methods.label: Read GET Value
methods.description: Reads one query-string value with a fallback, or returns the full GET array when no key is supplied.

methods.name: all
methods.label: Read All Request Data
methods.description: Reads one value or the complete data set from REQUEST.

methods.name: has_post
methods.label: Has POST Key
methods.description: Checks whether a POST key exists without treating valid zero values as missing.

methods.name: has_get
methods.label: Has GET Key
methods.description: Checks whether a GET key exists without treating valid zero values as missing.

methods.name: has_file
methods.label: Has Uploaded File
methods.description: Checks whether a single or array-style file input contains at least one uploaded file.

methods.name: files
methods.label: Read Uploaded Files
methods.description: Returns raw uploaded-file data from FILES for one field or all fields.

methods.name: set_upload_folder
methods.label: Set Upload Folder
methods.description: Sets the default destination folder used by uploaded fields that do not override it with a field rule.
methods.help:
Sets the default destination folder used by uploaded fields that do not override it with a field rule.

### Example

```php
$req->set_upload_folder('uploads/users');
```

### Notes

- All upload setters return the current Request object and can be chained.
- A per-field `folder` rule overrides this global value.

methods.name: set_upload_max_size
methods.label: Set Upload Max Size
methods.description: Sets the default maximum upload size and returns the Request object for chaining.
methods.help:
Sets the default maximum upload size and returns the Request object for chaining.

### Example

```php
$req->set_upload_max_size(5);
```

### Notes

- Per-field `max_size` overrides this global value.
- Keep limits appropriate for the field and server configuration.

methods.name: set_upload_file_types
methods.label: Set Allowed MIME Types
methods.description: Sets the allowed MIME types used by global upload validation.
methods.help:
Sets the allowed MIME types used by global upload validation.

### Example

```php
$req->set_upload_file_types([
    'image/jpeg',
    'image/png',
    'image/webp',
]);
```

### Notes

- MIME type is detected from the temporary file using `finfo_file()` or `mime_content_type()`.
- Validate MIME type and extension together.
- `any` is supported but should be used very carefully, especially for public uploads.

methods.name: set_upload_extensions
methods.label: Set Allowed Extensions
methods.description: Sets the allowed original filename extensions used by global upload validation.
methods.help:
Sets the allowed original filename extensions used by global upload validation.

### Example

```php
$req->set_upload_extensions([
    'jpg',
    'jpeg',
    'png',
    'webp',
]);
```

### Notes

- Extensions are checked from the original filename.
- Validate extensions together with real MIME types.
- Avoid `any` unless the workflow is controlled.

methods.name: set_file_prefix
methods.label: Set Filename Prefix
methods.description: Sets a prefix that is added to generated upload filenames.
methods.help:
Sets a prefix that is added to generated upload filenames.

### Example

```php
$req->set_file_prefix('user_');
```

### Notes

- The upload system also sanitizes the base name and adds a randomized value to reduce collisions and filename guessing.

methods.name: set_verify_images
methods.label: Verify Uploaded Images
methods.description: Enables or disables real-image verification for uploads intended to contain images.
methods.help:
Enables or disables real-image verification for uploads intended to contain images.

### Example

```php
$req->set_verify_images(true);
```

### Notes

- Image verification uses `getimagesize()` to check that a file behaves like a real image.
- Enable this for avatars, logos, gallery images, thumbnails, and cover art.

methods.name: set_image_dimensions
methods.label: Set Image Dimensions
methods.description: Sets global minimum and maximum image dimensions.
methods.help:
Sets global minimum and maximum image dimensions.

### Example

```php
$req->set_image_dimensions(200, 200, 3000, 3000);
```

### Notes

- Arguments represent minimum width, minimum height, maximum width, and maximum height.
- Failed dimension checks prevent the file from being moved and add an upload error.

methods.name: set_upload_rule
methods.label: Set Field Upload Rule
methods.description: Defines a complete upload configuration for one named file field.
methods.help:
Defines a complete upload configuration for one named file field.

### Example

```php
$req->set_upload_rule('avatar', [
    'folder' => 'uploads/avatars',
    'max_size' => 5,
    'mime_types' => ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'],
    'extensions' => ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
    'verify_image' => true,
    'min_width' => 150,
    'min_height' => 150,
    'max_width' => 3000,
    'max_height' => 3000,
    'prefix' => 'avatar_',
]);
```

### Notes

- Supported keys: `folder`, `max_size`, `mime_types`, `extensions`, `verify_image`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, and `prefix`.
- Per-field values override global upload settings for that field.

methods.name: get_upload_rule
methods.label: Get Field Upload Rule
methods.description: Returns the configured upload rule for one named field.
methods.help:
Returns the configured upload rule for one named field.

### Example

```php
$rule = $req->get_upload_rule('avatar');
print_r($rule);
```

### Notes

- Useful for inspecting the effective configuration of a field before processing.

methods.name: set_filename_callback
methods.label: Set Filename Callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for custom upload filename generation.

methods.name: upload_files
methods.label: Upload Files
methods.description: Processes one upload field or every uploaded field and returns saved path information.
methods.help:
Processes one upload field or every uploaded field and returns saved path information.

### Example

```php
$req = new \Core\Request();

$req->set_upload_rule('avatar', [
    'folder' => 'uploads/avatars',
    'max_size' => 5,
    'mime_types' => ['image/jpeg', 'image/png'],
    'extensions' => ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png'],
    'verify_image' => true,
]);

$avatar = $req->upload_files('avatar');
```

### Notes

- A single file from one named field returns a string path.
- A multiple field returns an array of paths.
- With no field argument, results are grouped by field name.
- Check `has_upload_errors()` after processing.

methods.name: upload_files_detailed
methods.label: Upload Files with Details
methods.description: Processes uploads and returns detailed metadata such as original name, saved path, MIME type, extension, size, and image dimensions.
methods.help:
Processes uploads and returns detailed metadata such as original name, saved path, MIME type, extension, size, and image dimensions.

### Example

```php
$req = new \Core\Request();

$req->set_upload_rule('document', [
    'folder' => 'uploads/documents',
    'max_size' => 10,
    'mime_types' => ['application/pdf'],
    'extensions' => ['pdf'],
]);

$result = $req->upload_files_detailed('document');
```

### Notes

- Detailed results can include `success`, `field_name`, `original_name`, `path`, `mime_type`, `extension`, `size`, `size_text`, and image `width`/`height`.
- Prefer this method when upload metadata will be stored in the database.

methods.name: has_upload_errors
methods.label: Has Upload Errors
methods.description: Returns true when validation, folder, or move errors were collected during upload processing.

methods.name: get_upload_errors
methods.label: Get Upload Errors
methods.description: Returns all collected upload errors grouped by field name.
methods.help:
Returns all collected upload errors grouped by field name.

### Example

```php
$errors = $req->get_upload_errors();
print_r($errors);
```

### Notes

- Errors are grouped by field name. System-level errors may appear under `_system`.

methods.name: get_upload_error_code
methods.label: Get Upload Error Code
methods.description: Returns the latest upload error code recorded by the request upload system.
methods.help:
Returns the latest upload error code recorded by the request upload system.

### Example

```php
$code = $req->get_upload_error_code();
echo $code;
```

### Notes

- This provides the most recent upload code alongside the human-readable error collection.

methods.name: clear_upload_errors
methods.label: Clear Upload Errors
methods.description: Clears the upload error messages and error-code state.
methods.help:
Clears the upload error messages and error-code state.

### Example

```php
$req->clear_upload_errors();
```

### Notes

- Use when reusing the Request object for another independent upload operation.

methods.name: ip
methods.label: Client IP Address
methods.description: Returns the client IP address detected for the current request.
methods.help:
Returns the client IP address detected for the current request.

### Example

```php
$req = new \Core\Request();
echo $req->ip();
```

### Notes

- Useful for logging and request diagnostics.

methods.name: uri
methods.label: Request URI
methods.description: Returns the current request URI.
methods.help:
Returns the current request URI.

### Example

```php
$req = new \Core\Request();
echo $req->uri();
```

### Notes

- Useful for route diagnostics and logging.

methods.name: server
methods.label: Read Server Value
methods.description: Reads one SERVER value with a fallback, or returns all server data when no key is supplied.

methods.name: header
methods.label: Read Header
methods.description: Reads a request header by converting its name to the corresponding SERVER key.
methods.help:
Reads a request header by converting its name to the corresponding SERVER key.

### Example

```php
$req = new \Core\Request();
$token = $req->header('Authorization');
```

### Notes

- Names such as `Authorization` are converted internally to their SERVER-style header key.
- Useful for API tokens and middleware-style checks.
